value.rationale: The explicitly defined P4-devoid functor is a natural classical nonflag simplicial complex. Complete torsion-sensitive homology of the two standard (16,6,2,2) nonisomorphic graphs exhibits a third-homology obstruction in exactly one; equality of graph valency, common-neighbor numbers, triangles and spectra cannot predict it. This is a motivated topological discrimination result, not a random parameter slice.
